Each truss is one 6.00 element from 1 to 3 (S-05 draws it as one continuous truss over three supports); not split at grid 2.

Roof overhang chain 1.00 + 3.00 + 3.00 + 1.00 (x) and 1.00 before A / 1.00 after E (y) recorded as dummies 1', 3', A', E'; D' (9.00) is the edge of the lower stair-roof sheet (1.00 + 1.00 between D and E).
หลังคาเมทัลชีท (roof sheeting leader) is roofing material, not a structural member — not recorded.
